fields.label: Ionic server host
fields.description: Host or hostname for the Ionic SQL query engine service.

fields.label: Ionic server port
fields.description: Port for Ionic SQL query service (default 443).

fields.label: Authentication realm
fields.description: Authentication realm name for OAuth2/Keycloak (default 'ionic').

fields.label: Default catalog
fields.description: Default catalog name for SQL queries (default 'ionic').

fields.label: Default schema
fields.description: Default schema name for SQL queries (default 'default').

fields.label: OAuth2 authentication URL
fields.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL for acquiring bearer tokens.

fields.label: OAuth2 authentication flow
fields.description: Authentication flow to use with OAuth2 (SERVICE_ACCOUNT, DIRECT, EXCHANGE, IMPERSONATION, DEVICE; default SERVICE_ACCOUNT).

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: OAuth2 client application ID.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.description: OAuth2 client application secret.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Username for direct user or impersonation authentication flows.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Password for direct user authentication flows.

fields.label: Session username
fields.description: Session user identity for query execution context.

fields.label: SSL verification mode
fields.description: SSL certificate verification mode (FULL, CA, NONE; default FULL).

fields.label: CA bundle path
fields.description: Path to custom CA certificate bundle.

fields.label: Client certificate path
fields.description: Path to client certificate file.

fields.label: Client key path
fields.description: Path to client private key file.

fields.label: Client key password
fields.description: Password for client private key file.

fields.label: Client source
fields.description: Client source identifier sent in session headers (default 'crogl').

fields.label: Client tags
fields.description: Comma-separated or JSON list of client tag strings associated with query sessions.

fields.label: Session properties
fields.description: JSON string for custom session configuration properties.
